label: Yahoo market quotes
description: Fetch structured equity/index quotes from Yahoo Finance (price, %1D, optional %5D, marketState, as_of) for downstream compose — language-neutral fields

description_i18n.en: Fetch structured equity/index quotes from Yahoo Finance (price, %1D, optional %5D, marketState, as_of) for downstream compose — language-neutral fields
description_i18n.zh_CN: 从 Yahoo Finance 拉取结构化报价（价格、%1D、可选 %5D、marketState、as_of）供下游成文；字段语言中立
description_i18n.zh_HK: 從 Yahoo Finance 拉取結構化報價（價格、%1D、可選 %5D、marketState、as_of）供下游成文；欄位語言中立

propose_guide: BEST WHEN: NL needs stock/index/FX/commodity levels or % changes. Prefer over web search for numeric quotes. Set symbols from NL (e.g. ^GSPC, SPY, DX-Y.NYB). include_history=true (default) adds approx %5D from daily chart. Output fields are language-neutral; compose follows workflow/Staff language. Do NOT invent prices when this step fails.

propose_guide_i18n.en: BEST WHEN: NL needs stock/index/FX/commodity levels or % changes. Prefer over web search for numeric quotes. Set symbols from NL (e.g. ^GSPC, SPY, DX-Y.NYB). include_history=true (default) adds approx %5D from daily chart. Output fields are language-neutral; compose follows workflow/Staff language. Do NOT invent prices when this step fails.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 最佳场景：需要指数/个股/外汇/商品价位或涨跌幅。数值优先本工具而非网页搜索。从 NL 填 symbols。默认 include_history=true 用日线近似 %5D。输出字段语言中立；成文跟 Workflow/Staff 语言。失败时禁止编造价格。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 最佳場景：需要指數/個股/外匯/商品價位或升跌幅。數值優先本工具而非網頁搜尋。從 NL 填 symbols。預設 include_history=true 用日線近似 %5D。輸出欄位語言中立；成文跟 Workflow/Staff 語言。失敗時禁止編造價格。

include_history.description: When true, enrich each quote with approx pct_5d from daily chart

params.name: include_history
params.description: Enrich with approx %5D from chart (default true)
